audit.why: Both layers already agree row by row (Akshan lvl 1, Skill lvl 2, K'Sante 3-5, Akshan 6, K'Sante items) and the prose matches each row. The packet chart differs, but the shipped chart is internally consistent and the mirror audit already chose to leave it — changing it here would fight the mirror.
audit.corrected: Chart left as shipped; disagreement with the packet recorded in notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The item spikes never accounted for Dirty Fighting's shield, so the burst maths on your all-in windows were wrong.
audit.why: Every third hit from Akshan's attacks and abilities shields him — your Q3-into-W burst hits a cushion unless the stacks are already spent.
audit.corrected: Shield stated in breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[2].text so you force it out before committing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate lines credited Akshan with 'Q/W poke' and 'W passive-mark damage'. Going Rogue (W) deals no damage at all.
audit.why: Riot's text for W is camouflage, Move Speed, Scoundrel marking and the resurrect — no poke component. His chip is Avengerang (Q, 9/8/7/6/5s) plus the passive's extra shot.
audit.corrected: whys[6], spikes[2].text and wants.foe[1] rewritten to name Avengerang and the double-shot passive; Heroic Swing's terrain requirement and champion-collision knock-off written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Engage when it's down' with no duration.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and needs terrain to fire into — the punish window is both long and location-dependent.
audit.corrected: 18s-to-12s and the terrain requirement now stated, with Avengerang's 9s-to-5s as the second gate.

edits.before: Late, his Q/W poke does nothing to your HP pool while your W stun denies his grapple escape — force side-lane fights and recall him out of position with R.
edits.after: Late, Avengerang and his Dirty Fighting shield do nothing to your HP pool while your W stun denies the grapple — force side-lane fights and R him out of position.

edits.before: All Out flips you to a duelist profile with bonus range — you survive his Q/W poke through the dash and out-DPS a squishy Akshan who has no way to burst a tank.
edits.after: All Out flips you to a duelist profile with bonus range — you survive Avengerang poke through the dash and out-DPS a squishy Akshan whose only cushion is his three-hit shield.

edits.before: Chip you down with Q Avengerang and W passive-mark damage before you ever bank a lead, then roam off his E mobility
edits.after: Chip you down with Avengerang and his double-shot passive before you bank a lead, then roam off Heroic Swing

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1 down to 12s — it needs terrain, and champion collision knocks him off it. - Avengerang: 9s down to 5s poke. - Dirty Fighting shields him every third hit — force it out before you commit. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Heroic Swing needs terrain and is 18s at rank 1 — walk into him where there is no wall to grapple.

edits.before: Chain Q slows on Akshan, Q3-knockup when his answer is down, W through the return damage, and decide: peel out or All Out.
edits.after: Chain Q slows on Akshan, Q3-pull once Heroic Swing is spent, W him into terrain for the stun, then peel out or All Out.
